CB.menuHint: Practice locally or, as GM, send a code-matrix challenge to a player.
CB.houseRule: Optional home rule / original matrix puzzle. Not official RED Netrunning.
CB.rules: Start in the top row. Then alternate the last cell's column and row. Each cell can be used once. Fill all target sequences contiguously in your buffer, in any order. The timer starts as soon as the board opens, even without a move.
CB.ready: Ready. Select a cell in the top row to start.
CB.full-buffer: Buffer full. Not all targets matched.
CB.invalidMove: Choose an unused cell on the active row or column.
CB.error: Cipher Breach could not complete this action. Check the console and your chat permissions; retry or ask your GM.
CB.untrusted: UNVERIFIED player report. Legal-move replay checks consistency only, not timing, identity authenticity or honest play. Retries are possible. The GM adjudicates manually; no actor, currency or world data is changed.
CB.closeWarning: Closing an unfinished run discards it. There is no resume. Finished assigned runs are reported automatically; if sending fails, use the send button.
CB.configHint: Buffer = 4 + half the Interface rank rounded up. Effective DV = base + failures + 2 x pressure conditions + 3 x enemy runners. Above DV rank + 12, time pressure increases; DV6 offers additional time. Each objective remains individually solvable; multiple objectives may not fit together in one buffer.
CB.configError: Unable to launch. Check DV, Interface rank (0-10), objective names and chat permissions. Details are in the console.
CB.challengeCard: Hey, choom. Your access is live. Jack in and crack those targets before the system kicks you out.
CB.invitationPublic: Cipher Breach / runner on the job.
CB.runnerDetected: Enemy runner: trace complete, hack detected.
CB.runnerNotDetected: Enemy runner: trace incomplete, hack not detected.
CB.consistent: The reported moves and outcome are logically consistent with the currently available GM-authored challenge. This is not an authoritative success or proof of elapsed time.
CB.invalidPayload: Invalid or unavailable Cipher Breach data; ask the GM to issue a new challenge.
CB.missingRank: No Netrunner role found. Practice rank 4 is proposed; the GM must check or change it.
CB.characterRank: Interface read from the assigned character's Netrunner role. The GM can override it.
CB.practiceRank: Local practice: choose an Interface rank.
CB.dead-end: Dead end. No legal cell remains.
CB.ice: No objective reached: the floor's ICE noticed the runner. The GM decides the consequences.
CB.previewHint: Browser simulation: configure as GM, launch for a sample character, then play as that participant. Results appear below. No Foundry server or real multiplayer is simulated.
CB.previewLaunched: GM invitation delivered. The board is open; the countdown is already running.
CB.hardHint: At effective DV16+: twelve codes and separate objective routes. At Interface 0 and effective DV17+, only one route per objective is complete, with misleading three-code paths. DV18/20 give rank 0 only 5/4.1 seconds. This also applies to single-objective breaches; at most one of three four-code objectives fits the buffer.
CB.modifierHint: The GM sets counts manually (0-10 per category). Pressure, haste and stealth count separately. Enemy runners add +3 DV and also reduce time: divide by (1 + 0.2 x count). Their visible counterhack trace follows elapsed time, not actual matrix moves. No automatic retry penalty: create a new invitation with an increased count for a harder retry. An old invitation retains its puzzle and values.
